spans.text: Night falls over the beach as the voting finally comes to an end.
4 Shiki takes the MVP slot through the number of Seals of the Wolfpack accumulated.
Shortly before the prize presentation ceremony, by the beach.
Step, step...
DP-12 and 4 Shiki travel further down the beach.
The bright lights recede into the distance behind them, leaving behind the hazy moonlight and the sound of lapping waves.
...Where are you taking me, Miss DP-12?
The prize presentation ceremony is about to—
Shhh...
DP-12 stops and presses a finger to her lips before flashing 4 Shiki an enigmatic smile.
Teehee...
Ehhh?!
You were faster than I expected, but that's a capable officer of the Werewolves for you.
Five-Seven slowly walks out from the shadow of the rocks and cuts off 4 Shiki's retreat.
You flatter me, my dear leader Five-Seven.
Wait a minute... what... You're a Werewolf, Miss DP-12?!
W-What are you going to do to me?!
Let's cut to the chase, Miss 4 Shiki. We know you're a Villager and we know the Commander picked you as tonight's winner.
Therefore, I'd like to make a little deal with you—
If you can help the Werewolves seize victory at the prize presentation afterwards, we Werewolves promise to help you keep quiet about an unmentionable secret. How's that?
Five-Seven pulls out a Werewolf card from behind her and wags it in front of 4 Shiki's face.
Hmph, I see now—You're trying to blackmail me!
Unfortunately for you, I have always been open and forthright in my dealings! I have never once had any unspeakable or unmentionable secrets or whatever.
I'll be off now.
Hang on for a bit, Miss 4 Shiki.
Do you see this?
The screen of DP-12's communicator lights up. The sudden flare of brilliance is dazzling in the darkness.
...Aiiieeeee!!!
Snap. The screen goes dark.
4 Shiki comes to her senses after screaming. Her face alternates between bright red and pale white and she has clearly been shaken.
No! Don't... Please don't!!!
You can't! You mustn't!!!
Hehe... Turns out you DO have an unmentionable secret after all, don't you?
Don't worry. It's not too late to turn things around.
Just remember our terms from just now, my dear 4 Shiki.
Five-Seven gently takes 4 Shiki's hand and presses the Werewolf card into it.
Don't worry, we'll keep our promise as long as you follow through.
We Werewolves always help each other, don't we?
I, I understand...
That's more like it. Gooooood girl~
Five-Seven ruffles 4 Shiki's head before exchanging winks with DP-12...
...On the prize presentation podium.
Excuse me, coming through...
A crowd has gathered for the upcoming prize ceremony. Five-Seven has a hard time squeezing her way forward.
Ah! Sorry!
The fluffy little head making its way through the crowd turns around and immediately collides with Five-Seven.
Hm? What are you doing?
Five-Seven smiles as she pats Gr G41's head, a rare look of good humor on her face.
I'm doing a headcount, Miss Five-Seven!
Miss C-MS said the champion would be here ahead of time. So as long as we find out who's not here, we'll know who the champion is!
Clever girl.What have you found so far?
Um... Actually, I noticed Miss Gr G36 and Miss Gr G28 vanished together!
That seems very suspicious!
Is it possible that they might have just gone to clean up the kitchen? After all, they've been making refreshments for everyone all night long...
See, they're here. 9 o'clock, in the direction of the kitchen~
Gr G41 looks where Five-Seven is pointing and realization dawns on her.
Ohhhhh, I see...
Then apart from them, the only people who haven't arrived yet are 4 Shiki and Miss NTW-20...
...You! Are! Late!
There is a loud shout from beside her.
NTW-20 grabs C-MS' hands as the latter claws at her long hair. She shoots back an angry retort in response to the smaller girl's scolding.
I TOLD you, I just finished setting up the stall!!!
How was I supposed to take care of it all by myself after you dragged DP-12 and 4 Shiki away?!
Who called them away? You're just making excuses!
And besides, DP-12 isn't one of us, is she?!
Then why did she spend all night with 4 Shiki?
Just how many Werewolves are there, anyway?
Looks like 4 Shiki's the only one who hasn't shown up yet~
Five-Seven pats Gr G41's head again and smiles, snapping Gr G41 out of her daze.
Oh yeah!
Thanks for reminding me! I need to tell Miss C-MS about this!
Gr G41 swishes her tail and works her way toward C-MS.
Five-Seven takes advantage of the opening she leaves to squirm her way forward.
Hey! Quit shoving—
Leader Five-Seven? Is that you?
Good evening~
Five-Seven leans on AA-12's shoulder, a position which affords her an unobstructed view of the prize presentation podium.
Leader, is it true the show's over for us?
In that case, can we wrap this prize presentation up quickly...
Who says it's over?
I feel like it's only just begun.
AA-12 has no idea why Five-Seven is acting so confident. All she can do is turn her gaze back to the podium...
...Several minutes later.
Spotlights illuminate the heated atmosphere on the podium.
And the MVP for Lycan Sanctuary today is—
4 Shiki!
Congratulations, 4 Shiki.
As applause and cheers wash over here, 4 Shiki accepts the prize plaque while bowing her head uneasily.
Teehee... You got more Signs of the Wolfpack than Proofs of Goodness.
But as we all know, the real winner is decided by the MVP's team affiliation!
Now then, the moment we've all been waiting for, the single move which can decide success or failure—
Miss 4 Shiki, what is your true identity?
I, my identity is...
4 Shiki presses her lips together, then takes a deep breath.
I'm—
I'm a Werewolf!
4 Shiki squeezes her eyes shut and holds up her Werewolf card, her hands trembling.
The crowd instantly falls silent, but tension begins boiling among the Dolls and unease fills the air.
...Wait, really? I thought she was—
Shhhh...
C-MS, you liar! You said 4 Shiki was a Villager! You said it was a sure bet!!!
It, it can't be... I couldn't have been wrong!!!
Hey! Where's NTW? Get out here!!
C-MS' shout grabs everyone's attention.
Didn't 4 Shiki help you guard your stall tonight? Is she or is she not a Werewolf?!
I think she's a Villager.
NTW's keen gaze turns to the stage. She can tell that 4 Shiki is lying.
Where's your proof for that?
4 Shiki's Villager role card fell out of her pocket while she was helping to set up the stall. I helped her pick it up.
You can check my neural records if you don't believe me.
I'll testify to that too—4 Shiki's a Villager!
Don't mess around with us anymore, Miss 4 Shiki! That Werewolf card must be fake, right?
No... it's not...
4 Shiki nervously glances at DP-12 and Five Seven, and her voice goes up by an octave.
I... I'm not messing around, really!
I, uh, I really am a Werewolf! I, I've been playing you all like a fiddle from the beginning!
I'm, I'm an irredeemable sinner, and I... bweeeehhhh...
I'm sorry!!!!
...I can't take this anymore.
4 Shiki, you—
Calm down.
Gr G36 quietly emerges from the crowd and gently places a hand on NTW's shoulder.
It's still too early to assign blame or demand apologies. What we need to do right now is reveal the truth.
Therefore, Miss 4 Shiki...
...Huh?
If you can answer the question that I'm about to ask, I'll admit you're a Werewolf and I'll let tonight's events slide. How about that?
O-Okay!
4 Shiki calms herself as she desperately reaches for what might be her lifeline.
As a Werewolf, who are your teammates? Please identify them clearly.
4 Shiki has no obligation to—
We have been monitoring all external communications and hints in real time.
So, what's your answer, Miss 4 Shiki?
I... um... My teammates are...
4 Shiki bites her lip as everyone stares at her at the same time.
Uh, DP-12, Five-Seven, Type... Type 95...?
Very good, continue.
Er... and... there's...
Gr... Gr G41?
Ehhhhhh?! But I'm a Villager!!!
Don't look at me like that, I'm innocent bweeeeehhhhh...
Wrong, you idiot!
Quiet, you!
Unfortunately, that was wrong, Miss 4 Shiki.
Gr G28, if you'll do the honors.
Got it!
Whoosh—
A petite form nimbly darts out from behind the backdrop and appears behind 4 Shiki.
Uwaaaahhh—What are you doing?!
Creak, creak... Coarse ropes wrap around 4 Shiki, firmly binding her struggling form.
Let go of her! What are you doing to one of our Werewolves?!
Commander— Miss Kalina—!
Tap tap tap—On the beach, racing feet leave nothing but two sets of footprints behind them.
The Dolls freeze up for a moment, and then they revert to their savage, basic instincts, pushing and shoving each other as they swarm the stage...
"What are we going to do"? Of COURSE we're going to pry open Miss 4 Shiki's neural cloud and check her neural records!
How could someone as pure and innocent as 4 Shiki tell lies? You Werewolf mutts must have been secretly manipulating her!
Never fear, 4 Shiki! We'll save you!!!
Gr G28 grips 4 Shiki's shoulder tightly and yanks her back and forth like she's rowing a boat.
Uwaaahhhhh—
On the other side, the Werewolves grab 4 Shiki's right shoulder and follow suit, like they can snatch back victory if they pull hard enough.
Don't try to smear our reputations just because you lost!
Even the Commander, who sees everything, voted for Miss 4 Shiki with Signs of the Wolfpack! What are you even struggling for?!
...Owowowowow!
Ah! My bag...
Zzzzzzip.
The zipper of 4 Shiki's bag slides open, spilling her Villager's card, which ends up being stomped by the densely-packed crowd.
At the same time, 4 Shiki's communicator falls to the beach with a thump.
Beep!
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!
Who was that?! Who was screaming?!!
It's as though someone had pushed the pause button on the chaotic scene. Everyone simultaneously turns to look at the source of the sound—
Crackle... crackle...
4 Shiki's communicator shines amidst the grains of sand.
Ooooohhhhhh... I just loved that latest chapter of "50 Shades of Griffin"!!!!
So good... yeah, anh ahggh anhhhh, yeeeeaaahhhhh...
Eeep...!
4 Shiki struggles valiantly, to no avail.
Ogggghhhhhhhh yeeeeeeaaaaahhhh!
Sooooo gooooood!!
That felt great!!!!
4 Shiki is the greatest doujin artist in Griffin!!
YOU ARE MY GOOOOOODDDDDD—
Beep. The message ends.
Huh? Why does Miss Saiga-12 sound so excited?
Pardon me, 4 Shiki.
Gr G36 bends down and picks up the communicator before going through it.
The curious crowd abandons their tug of war and crowds in closer to look.
Don't...!
Uwow! I didn't know Miss Gr G41 was a popular manga artist!
What are all these titles she released, "Secret Romance of the Tsundere Team Leader and the Two-Faced Vice-Captain", "Doki Doki Ops Room", "I Can't Believe My Head Maid Is This Cute"...
Say, what does R18 mean? And why do all these titles have that logo on it?
Those are, those are top secret documents! Kids not allowed!
Ohhhhh...
Gr G41's ears and head nod gently, but her curious eyes are still scanning the screen. This lasts until Gr G36 sighs and turns off the communicator.
I think I get it now.
Your comm log between you and DP-12 explains everything...
They used your... personal preferences as a level to blackmail you, didn't they, 4 Shiki?
Bweehhh... It's not... I didn't...
4 Shiki struggles against her bonds, to no avail.
Miss 4 Shiki, this concerns the fairness of the Lycan Sanctuary game.
Therefore, I would like to reveal the truth behind the matter—
No! Don't! I do not consent!
Bweeeehhh... How am I going to face anyone else after this...!!!
Thud!
4 Shiki struggles free of her bonds, grabs the communicator and runs into the desolate beach, her wails fading behind her...
Wait a minute, 4 Shiki!
At least explain why you did it!
NTW chases her without hesitation.
Don't run, NTW! Ahhhh...
Careful, careful! Coming through, coming through... Whoa!
Hey! What are you guys doing?!
Let go of me! Get out of my way! Hey...!
On the stage, the previously united mass of Villagers finally loses control. The pursuers, the blockers and the onlookers blend together into a chaotic mess.
Fresh disorder brews amidst the yells and scuffling...
Elsewhere, on the beach.
Beep! Beep!
As 4 Shiki flees, the communicator in her hand emits one message tone after another.
Whew! Good thing Miss Gr G36 didn't see our chat log!
Run faster, Miss 4 Shiki!
I'm trying to slow NTW down!
I deleted all the files from earlier, so make sure you delete all the files on your end too! Don't forget!!!
4 Shiki!!! I didn't know you were that legendary doujin artist!!!
I'm your biggest fan! Add me as a friend!
Come on, add me!!!
Are you going to sell your doujins?
I'll take all the R18 ones! Name your price!
Aaaaaahhhhhh— What a sin! What a sin!
I... I should just kill myself!!!
A stampede of footprints streak across the beach like comets, vanishing into the distance.
As a strange wail of despair rises into the air, flocks of seagulls flap their wings as they take wing and vanish into the argent moonlight...
Lycan Sanctuary [END]
